entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'Stillness of the Tomb'
identity: Infuse yourself the power of death and take on the mien of a corpse.  You will not breathe or move while it is in effect and enemies will assume you are dead.  You cannot weave this glamour twice in quick succession and expect the same enemies to be fooled again.  The glamour is <color_red>more expensive</color> in summer.
